name: twitch-vod-unmuter
description: Browser extension (Chrome and Firefox) that restores the sound in muted parts of Twitch VODs

scripts.start:chrome: node build.mjs && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.check-version: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs'),m=require('./manifest.json'),p=require('./package.json'),r=fs.readFileSync('README.md','utf8'),c=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'),v=m.version;if(p.version!==v)throw new Error('manifest '+v+' != package '+p.version);if(!r.includes('chrome-'+v+'.zip')||!r.includes('firefox-'+v+'.zip'))throw new Error('README.md zip version != '+v);if(!c.includes('\n## '+v))throw new Error('CHANGELOG.md missing ## '+v);"
